adv.endpoint_hint: An OpenAI-compatible URL. The API key is read only from the SONIVRA_API_KEY environment variable
adv.gpu_layers_hint: -1 means all layers, 0 means CPU only
adv.history_hint: Helps continuity, larger values are slower
adv.interim_translate_hint: When the translator is idle, translates the provisional text and shows it dimmed under it. Adds GPU load, skipped while latency is high, and a new sentence always takes priority. Applies on next start.
adv.model_info_empty: Format, parameters and device appear here after a model loads.
adv.performance_note: GPU figures are whole-device NVML usage, not just Sonivra. File processing time is not live latency.
adv.refine_hint: When the translator is idle, translates the previous sentence again with the next one as context and updates the screen and log if it changed. Good for slow-paced interviews. Applies on next start.
adv.runtime_note: Changes apply the next time you start.
audio.app_only_hint: Other programs, notifications and games are left out. The list shows programs with a window right now. Press Refresh above if yours is missing. If the program closes, Sonivra retries every second and reconnects when it returns.
audio.mix_mic_hint: Mixes the default microphone into the source above, so a call can translate both sides. With speakers the microphone hears them and text repeats, so use headphones. Only applies to system sound, and switching reconnects audio without reloading models.
audio.record_hint: Saves the sound sent to recognition, silence included, as a WAV in the transcripts folder, one file per start, 16 kHz mono, about 115 MB per hour. It starts together with the transcript.
audio.silence_hint: Shorter is faster but may cut sentences
audio.source_hint: For videos or streams, choose system playback. Switching does not reload models.
audio.vad_hint: Detection is based on loudness (RMS energy), so background music can trigger it too.
banner.reload: Model settings changed. Reload to apply them.
confirm.clear_log: Clear {0} lines from memory? Files already saved are kept.
confirm.reset_look: Reset the subtitle look to defaults? Position, size and lock stay as they are.
dialog.title: Sonivra
err.asr_load: The speech recognition model failed to load
err.settings: Settings could not be saved or applied
err.translation_load: The translation model failed to load
fix.asr: Press Retry. If it keeps happening, open the details.
fix.asr_load: Check the file on the Models page, or try the CPU and a smaller model.
fix.audio: Check that the device is still connected, or pick another source on the Audio page.
fix.download: The downloaded part is kept. Check the network and press Retry to resume.
fix.file: Check that the file exists, is not in use and has the right format.
fix.overlay: Use the Sonivra icon in the notification area to reset the position or unlock.
fix.settings: Check that values are within range and that the settings folder is writable.
fix.translation: Press Retry. For an external service, check the network and URL.
fix.translation_load: The GPU may be out of memory. Lower the GPU layers or choose a smaller model.
fix.translation_test: Make sure the translation model and runtime are ready, then try again.
home.no_text: No subtitles yet. Recognized text appears here after you start.
home.transcript_note: Retention and saving to file are set on the Transcript page
hotkey.failed: These shortcuts are taken by another program: {0}
hotkey.forward: Next line, then back to live
hotkey.title: Global shortcuts, also work while clicks pass through
lang.context_hint: For example the show type or who appears in it. Helps word choice.
lang.format_hint: PLaMo and HY-MT use their own prompt formats
lang.glossary_hint: One pair per line, written as  original = translation
lang.hints_hint: Names and terms, separated by commas
lang.no_partial: Provisional text appears every 0.8 s while speaking and is replaced by the final result. With automatic detection the translation source is automatic too, but mixed-language speech is not guaranteed to be recognized or translated correctly.
lang.test_hint: Checks the translation model without capturing audio.
log.empty: No subtitles yet. Every recognized line appears here once you start.
log.follow_hint: Turn off to freeze the list while you read back
log.keep_hint: Oldest lines go first. Cleared when Sonivra closes.
log.live_file: Write live subtitle to a text file
log.live_file_hint: Writes the on-screen subtitle to transcripts\live.txt. An OBS text source can read it, so you do not need to capture the overlay.
log.save_files_hint: Each finished line is appended with its time to the transcripts folder, one file per session
log.view_limit: Only the latest {0} are listed here. Export includes every kept line.
model.downloaded_verified: Downloaded, loaded on this PC before
model.selected_verified: Selected, loaded on this PC before
models.license_note: Each model has its own license. Source and license are shown before download.
models.reserve: GPU memory reserved for other programs (MB)
models.reserve_hint: What games or streaming software need. 0 is allowed
overlay.bar_hint: Title bar collapsed. Point at the subtitles to bring it back.
overlay.locked_hint: Locked. Hover the subtitles to unlock
overlay.locked_hint_pass: Locked with click-through. Press {0} to unlock
overlay.scroll_hint: While unlocked, drag any edge or corner to resize. Scroll to review earlier lines, Ctrl+scroll for text size, Shift+scroll for background. Right-click opens settings.
page.advanced_desc: Performance figures, engine parameters and runtime paths.
page.audio_desc: Choose what to listen to and when sound counts as speech.
page.home_desc: Check that everything is ready, then press Start.
page.language_desc: Set the spoken language, translation direction and terms.
page.models_desc: Pick, download or point to model files for this PC.
page.subtitles_desc: Every change shows up at once in the preview and the subtitle window without reloading models.
page.transcript_desc: Search, review and export what Sonivra heard. Times are when each line appeared on screen.

rec.estimate: Models need about {0} MiB of a {1} MiB budget
settings.close_note: Closing this window keeps subtitles running
settings.title: Sonivra Settings
setup.audio_detail: Play a video and watch the level move
setup.intro: Complete these steps once. After that, just press Start. You can pick model files you already have instead of downloading.
setup.overlay_detail: Use the preview to adjust position, size and font
setup.title: First-time setup
status.music_hint: Sound keeps coming in but no speech was recognized. Music and noise also trigger detection. Try a lower sensitivity on the Audio page.
status.no_audio: No sound for 20 seconds. Check the audio source and that something is playing.
subs.bar_hint: Shown only while unlocked. When hidden, use right-click, the tray icon or shortcuts.
subs.click_through_hint: While click-through is on, unlock with Ctrl+Alt+L or the notification area icon
subs.fit_hint: When off, the background spans the window
subs.history_hint: Earlier lines stay above, smaller, and older ones fade. With Fill the window, drag the window taller to see more
subs.history_mode_hint: Whether earlier lines show the translation, the original, or both. The current sentence follows the setting above
subs.hold_hint: How long a line stays without a new one
subs.interim_hint: Recognizes every 0.8 s mid-sentence and shows it dimmed. The final result replaces it and gets translated
subs.profile_hint: Saves the look, context note, glossary and recognition hints as one file to load when you switch programs. Window position and size are not included.
subs.show_status_hint: Such as paused or no sound. Errors always show.
